title: Muted Cel
description: Un style d'illustration 2D chaleureux et lo-fi, caractérisé par des contours fins, organiques et légèrement tremblants, ainsi qu'une géométrie imparfaite dessinée à la main. Il utilise une palette pastel douce avec des couleurs en aplat et un ombrage ambiant minimal.
description_en: A cozy, lo-fi 2D illustration style characterized by thin, slightly wobbly organic outlines and imperfect hand-drawn geometry. It utilizes a high-key, muted pastel palette with completely flat colors and minimal, soft ambient shading.
description_fr: Un style d'illustration 2D chaleureux et lo-fi, caractérisé par des contours fins, organiques et légèrement tremblants, ainsi qu'une géométrie imparfaite dessinée à la main. Il utilise une palette pastel douce avec des couleurs en aplat et un ombrage ambiant minimal.
prompt: Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. Render as a 2D digital indie animation still or lo-fi webcomic illustration, utilizing a muted, high-key pastel color palette. The foundational rendering technique relies on thin, slightly wobbly, organic dark-grey or sepia outlines that define every object with a charming, hand-drawn irregularity. Fill these contoured shapes with completely flat, untextured blocks of {{primary_color}} and {{secondary_color}}. Lighting is predominantly ambient and diffuse, creating a flat aesthetic with very minimal, soft cel-shaded shadows applied only in the deepest crevices using slightly darker, desaturated hues of the base colors. Introduce {{accent_color}} sparingly for small focal details. Avoid pure blacks, stark whites, and high-contrast gradients entirely. The spatial dynamics should feel slightly flattened, employing a casual, 2D perspective where geometry and structural lines are charmingly imperfect and skewed. Text or intricate details should appear hand-lettered and sketchy. The overall atmosphere is cozy, quiet, and nostalgic, reminiscent of slice-of-life indie cartoons. Edges are crisp but organic, dictated by the continuous, uniform-weight linework. The image must occupy the absolute entire dedicated space as a canvas rule: no borders, no frames, no white margins, no canvas edges, full bleed to all four corners. tags: 2d animation, indie webcomic, pastel color palette, thin organic linework, flat shading, lo-fi aesthetic, hand-drawn geometry, cozy atmosphere, muted tones, slice-of-life, full bleed, edge-to-edge, no border, no frame

video.motion: Subtle line boiling effect simulating hand-drawn animation at a low frame rate (12fps). Movements are gentle, flat, and charmingly imperfect.
video.camera: Static camera or slow, flat 2D panning with absolutely zero parallax depth.
video.temporal_texture: The thin outlines must constantly boil slightly, maintaining a continuous hand-drawn, sketchy consistency over time.
video.avoid: Smooth 60fps interpolation, 3D camera movements, motion blur, complex lighting shifts, and realistic physics.
